title: pH Formula
text: The formula is pH = -log[H+]. You already calculated log[H+] = -3.60

title: Apply the Negative Sign
text: pH = -(-3.60) = 3.60. The negative of a negative gives a positive value.

title: Interpret the Result
text: pH = 3.60 is less than 7, confirming this is an acidic solution. This makes sense given the relatively high [H+].
